vulnerability: BFLA - Regular user can access admin endpoint /api/v1/admin/users
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Register a new regular user via POST /api/v1/auth/register
2. Login as that user via POST /api/v1/auth/login to obtain JWT token
3. Use the JWT token (role: 'user') to access GET /api/v1/admin/users
4. Observe that the endpoint returns 200 OK with complete user listing including admin users
impact: A regular authenticated user (role: 'user') can access the administrative endpoint /api/v1/admin/users and retrieve a list of ALL users in the system, including admin users. This exposes sensitive information about all users including administrators (usernames, emails, roles, IDs, bios, etc.).
